response.original_title: ((FAQ™ Cabin Guide)) How do I add a room to my MSC Cruise?
response.overview: To add a new room or an additional guest to an existing Carnival Cruise, you must call Carnival Cruise customer service directly at 1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada), 1-866-829-1280, or contact your travel advisor. To add an additional room or cabin to an existing MSC cruise, 1-866-829-1280 (US) you cannot do it yourself online. You must call MSC directly at 1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK), or contact your travel agent to create a new, separate booking for the extra cabin and link it to your original reservation. To add an entirely separate room to an existing MSC Cruise booking, you cannot do it directly inside your current online account. You must call MSC customer service at +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or contact your travel agent to book a new, separate stateroom and link the reservations together.
